picks.reasoning: HLE has the stronger individuals, and Zeka's 5.7 KDA with 26% damage share is the kind of carry that decides a single game. TES's numbers are a 9-11 record with a 35% first-tower rate, and their comebacks don't outweigh that.

Tempo says HLE: they're +0.6k at 15 with 60% first towers and 45% first dragons, while TES sits at -0.4k with just 35% first towers and 30% first dragons, so HLE should own the map early. TES's comeback habit is real, but I'd rather bet on the team that starts the game ahead on objectives.

Drafts favor HLE: their Fearless-proof pools (Orianna, Syndra, Ahri, Ashe, Caitlyn) give them more depth than TES's Olaf and Renekton lean, and their 30-14 series record and MSI/EWC results back that up. TES's 1-in-3 Baron and 35% tower-taking edge is the risk, so I'm not going above 60.

HLE has the stronger record: 74-49 in games and 30-14 in series, against TES's 76-64 and 27-24, and they have won more of their recent big-stage matches. The edge is moderate, though, since neither side has a head-to-head sample and HLE's last 10 games are only 6-4.

HLE's record and the way they've carried themselves through the big stages suggest a settled group, even with the shaky recent form. TES has been losing more than it wins lately, and I worry about the mood in that room, though their two comeback wins show they can hold a team together when it counts.
